title: Murder / homicide
summary: This topic covers culpable homicide, murder, punishment for murder, and culpable homicide not amounting to murder.

title: Criminal breach of trust
summary: This topic covers criminal breach of trust, commonly known as CBT or pecah amanah, including general CBT and CBT by employees, agents, bankers, public servants and other trusted persons.

title: Cheating / scam
summary: This topic covers cheating, fraud-like conduct, deception and dishonestly inducing delivery of property.

title: Theft
summary: This topic covers theft and punishment for theft.

title: Robbery
summary: This topic covers when theft or extortion becomes robbery, and punishment for robbery.

title: Forgery
summary: This topic covers forgery, forged documents, forgery for cheating, and using forged documents as genuine.

title: Defamation
summary: This topic covers criminal defamation and punishment for defamation.

title: Criminal intimidation
summary: This topic covers threats, intimidation and punishment for criminal intimidation.
